exposure: head circumference-to-abdomen circumference z score ratio
interval between ultrasound examination and birth
outcome: Large for gestational age (birthweight >90th percentile for gestational age)
cohort: 2465 patients with a singleton live birth at ≥36 weeks of gestation complicated by preexisting or gestational diabetes mellitus observed at a single tertiary center between January 2011 and May 2022
finding: The prediction models developed in the study, incorporating various maternal and fetal factors, showed greater predictive accuracy for macrosomia, large for gestational age, and birthweight than estimated fetal weight alone.
